description: This file defines an abstract base class 'PluginManagerBase' for managing plugins within the Drupal framework. It includes methods for discovering, creating, and handling plugins, as well as fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: PluginManagerBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing core functionality for plugin managers, including discovery, instantiation, and fallback handling.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the definition of a plugin by its ID, with optional exception on invalid.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of a plugin by its ID, with fallback if the plugin is not found.

methods.name: handlePluginNotFound
methods.description: Handles cases where a plugin is not found, attempting to use a fallback plugin ID.

methods.name: getFallbackPluginId
methods.description: Abstract method to get a fallback plugin ID for missing plugins; throws exception if not implemented.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance from the mapper with given options, if supported.
